description: This PHP file defines functions related to displaying filesystems information, including generating XML, HTML, and WML outputs of filesystem data. It interacts with global system info objects and constructs formatted representations of filesystem data, such as mounted filesystems, their sizes, used space, and other attributes.

methods.name: xml_filesystems
methods.description: Generates an XML representation of the system's filesystems, including details such as mount points, types, device names, utilization percentages, free space, used space, and total size.

methods.name: html_filesystems
methods.description: Creates an HTML table displaying filesystem information, including mount points, types, device names, usage bars, free and used space, and total size.

methods.name: wml_filesystem
methods.description: Builds a WML card with filesystem details suitable for mobile devices, showing mount points or device names along with free, used, and total sizes.
